prompt: A 90-degree overhead archival flatbed scan of a minimalist hand-drawn architectural manifesto and social preview card on warm off-white millimeter graph paper (#FAF8F4), illustrated with a fine 0.38mm dark navy-black ballpoint pen and a fine red ballpoint drafting pen.
